verdict.rationale: Pika documents a Talking Head presenter that can use your own image and audio, plus reusable custom characters. Nothing in the evidence describes a consent capture or identity verification flow for creating an avatar of a real person. Using an uploaded image is a related feature, not the documented consent and verification flow the story requires, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can create a custom avatar of a real person through a documented consent and verification flow
